name: NCAA D-III West Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Spokane Valley, WA · host Whitworth · The Course Spokane Valley
headline: NCAA D-III West Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Men: No. 15 Pomona-Pitzer, No. 25 Claremont-Mudd-Scripps and No. 28 George Fox. Women: No. 11 Pomona-Pitzer, No. 12 Claremont-Mudd-Scripps, No. 19 George Fox, No. 25 Colorado College, No. 29 Whitworth (the host) and No. 30 Trinity (Texas). Nationals bids are on the line for the NCAA D-III Championships on Nov. 21 in Northfield, Minn. · Women 6K 11:00 a.m. PT · Men 8K 12:00 p.m. PT
